_comment: Pre-computed circuit witnesses for the demo. Field names match the circom
signal names exactly, so these can be fed straight to snarkjs.
aadhaar_secret is the Poseidon-domain secret derived from the citizen's
Aadhaar reference id; it never leaves the device and is not recoverable from

test_age_proof.description: Age >= 18 for Madhan Kumar (DOB 10-07-1998), verified on 2026-07-10

expected.note: Turns 28 on the verification date itself — exercises the birthday-boundary path.

test_age_proof_underage.description: Age >= 18 for Minor Test (DOB 01-01-2015) — must be UNPROVABLE

expected.note: Witness generation must fail. The circuit constrains age >= threshold, so no proof exists.

test_location_proof.description: Andhra Pradesh resident (state code 28), district and pincode unconstrained

expected.note: 0 in a required_* field means 'any' — the citizen reveals state only, not district or pincode.

test_location_proof_wrong_state.description: Maharashtra resident (27) attempting to prove AP residency (28) — must be UNPROVABLE

test_citizenship_proof.description: Holds a UIDAI-signed Aadhaar — nothing else revealed

test_compound_proof.description: Banking KYC: Indian citizen AND 18+ AND Andhra Pradesh resident, in one proof
